1._section_summary: This Discussion section presents findings from a study examining the relationship between Big Five personality traits and body image outcomes (drive for muscularity and body appreciation) in men. The results indicate that Neuroticism is significantly associated with greater drive for muscularity and lower body appreciation, while Extraversion is positively associated with body appreciation. The authors discuss theoretical mechanisms underlying these associations and propose practical implications for mental health practitioners and future research directions.
